items.title: Russia Moves to Tamp Down Rumors About Plague Outbreak in Siberia
items.summary: The country’s consumer watchdog has said only that “an employee of an anti-plague institute in the Irkutsk Region” contracted pneumonia. Rumors and unconfirmed reports sounded a more ominous note.

items.title: Brazil Election Could Give Bolsonaro a Key Role in Trump’s Latin America Map
items.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro, now the favorite to win Brazil’s presidency, would give President Trump a critical new ally in Latin America, particularly on security.

items.title: Spain’s Leader Calls an Early Election
items.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of Spain has faced rising challenges to his authority amid a migration crisis and several corruption scandals involving his inner circle.

items.title: Why Saudi Arabia’s Last War in Yemen Turned Into a Quagmire
items.summary: A Saudi-led coalition has announced a military campaign against the Iran-backed Houthi militia in the country, reviving memories of its previous effort.

items.title: In a Major Boost for the Right, Another Bolsonaro Nears Brazil’s Presidency
items.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro’s first round lead leaves President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva three weeks to find the votes to stop Brazil’s, and Latin America’s, rightward shift.

items.title: Trapped in a Kill Zone, a Ukrainian City Is Beginning to Starve
items.summary: Evacuation is almost impossible and food is running out in Russian-occupied Oleshky, a city menaced by mines and drones.

items.title: How Congo’s Ebola Epidemic Got So Bad So Quickly
items.summary: What happened in Mangala, where residents were left with little outside support, helps explain how this outbreak became the worst seen in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

items.title: Turkey Banned a Book by a Jailed Presidential Hopeful. We Read It.
items.summary: From jail, the former mayor of Istanbul accuses President Recep Tayyip Erdogan of hollowing out Turkey’s democracy to stay in power.

items.title: Voters in Quebec Election Go to Polls as Separatist Parti Québécois Leads

items.title: Pay Phone, a Lifeline During 2019 Australia Wildfires, Gains Heritage Status
items.summary: Hundreds lined up to call loved ones as the internet went down and the flames closed in on the Australian town of Narooma in 2019.

items.title: Nashville Symphony Receives $10 Million Lifeline From Oracle
items.summary: The symphony announced last week that it was pausing the rest of the season after disclosing financial trouble. The concerts are back on now, thanks to a tech company gift.

items.title: High Interest Rates Aren’t Slowing the A.I. Boom. That’s a Problem for the Fed.
items.summary: Rising borrowing costs are taking a toll on households and businesses. But they are doing little to dampen enthusiasm for investments in A.I. infrastructure, which are contributing to inflation.

items.title: Texas Pediatricians Face Paxton Investigations for Vaccinating Children
items.summary: Ken Paxton, the Texas attorney general and Republican Senate candidate, has alleged a sprawling profit-driven conspiracy. Pediatricians say the accusations are an attempt at intimidation.

items.title: War With Iran Is Forcing the World to Reckon With Geography’s Power

items.title: Burst of Attacks in Gulf Heightens Fears Over Fragile Energy Trade

items.title: Karoline Leavitt, Trump’s ‘Machine Gun,’ Has a New Gig at Fox News
items.summary: A fierce and nimble speaker, Ms. Leavitt is the third of Mr. Trump’s former press secretaries to join the cable news network.

items.title: CNN C.E.O. Mark Thompson Says He Will Stay On Under New Owner Skydance
items.summary: Mark Thompson told the network’s employees that he had faith that David Ellison, the chief executive of Skydance, would support “independent news that CNN has always stood for.”

items.title: What’s the Right “Level of Care” for A.I.?
items.summary: Another executive departed OpenAI, raising questions about the company’s commitment to safety.

items.title: 5 Challenges David Ellison Faces as Warner Bros. Discovery and Paramount Merge
items.summary: The tech scion has given his combination of Warner Bros. Discovery and Paramount a new name: Skydance. Now he must make tough decisions about news, movies, streaming, sports and debt.

items.title: Supreme Court Tangles Over a Major Climate Change Case

items.title: Inside Binance Founder Changpeng Zhao’s Life After Prison

items.title: OpenAI’s Greg Brockman Backs Out of Second $25 Million Donation to A.I. Super PAC

items.title: How Meta Uses A.I. Data Centers to Avoid Billions in Federal Taxes

items.title: The Humanoid Robot Future Has Arrived at a South Korean Park. Sort of.

items.summary: Five humans convened for a weekend to create new music from scratch. Could they do better than A.I.? Could you even tell the difference?
